data: Je vous souhaite d'être follement aimée (Looking for Her)

Elisa, kinésithérapeute, part s’installer avec son jeune fils, Noé, à Dunkerque, ville où elle est née sous X. Quelques mois plus tôt, elle y a entrepris des recherches sur sa mère biologique, mais cette femme a refusé de dévoiler son identité. À la recherche d’une mère inconnue, de son passé et de leur histoire, Élisa ne renonce pas et veut comprendre… Le hasard va bouleverser ses attentes... (Elisa, a physiotherapist, settles with her young son, Noé, in Dunkirk, where she was adopted out at birth. A few months earlier, she'd tried to locate her birth mother there, but the latter had refused to reveal her identity. Elisa is looking for an unknown mother, her past and their story, and she won't give up, she wants to understand... Chance will drastically change all her expectations.)

Elisa, a physiotherapist, settles with her young son, Noé, in Dunkirk, where she was adopted out at birth. A few months earlier, she'd tried to locate her birth mother there, but the latter had refused to reveal her identity. Elisa is looking for an unknown mother, her past and their story, and she won't give up, she wants to understand... Chance will drastically change all her expectations.
